name: Layer Stack
alt: Three map sheets stacked above one another: a field of data points, the road network, and the finished map with a river, a park and a route between two pins.

name: Rush Hour
alt: A two-lane road in a jam: two cars stopped nose to tail in each lane, the road empty behind them.

name: Hazard Ahead
alt: A car broken down askew in its lane on a two-lane road, a traffic cone behind it and smoke rising off its bonnet.

name: Lens and Pin
alt: A magnifying glass held over a street map, with a map pin rising up through the lens.

name: Live Streets
alt: A map tile with a connected network of roads, low buildings, and traffic dashes on the main road.

name: Ask the Way
alt: A chat bubble whose tail is a map pin, standing on a street map, with an AI spark at its corner and a dashed route to a destination.

name: Ask for Places
alt: A chat bubble whose tail is a map pin, standing on a street map, with an AI spark at its corner and map pins rising from places, one of them chosen.

name: Connected Globe
alt: A globe with service points on it, linked by arcs to one hub, and two AI sparks beside it.

name: Dotted Earth
alt: A globe whose continents are drawn in fine dots, Europe and Africa facing the viewer, a scatter of dots on the land lit where data is coming in.

name: Dropped Pin
alt: A map marker, a pin with a round hole through its head, hovering over a round pad, the spot it marks.

name: Tile Service
alt: A grid of map tiles with one missing, a server just above the empty slot, linked to two other services.

name: Round the Corner
alt: A car on a street map seen from above, with a route round the corner to a destination pin.

name: Modular Cockpit
alt: A tablet lying on a table, its interface built of modules set into slots: a map with a route from a chevron to a pin, lane guidance and a trip panel.

name: Probable Path
alt: A car in the middle lane of a three-lane road, faint sensor arcs at its front corners, and ahead of it the lane it will most likely take picked out with a row of chevrons.

name: Free Bay
alt: A car parked in its bay, and beside it a free bay with a parking marker, a P, floating over it.

name: Load Order
alt: A delivery van with its back doors open and three parcels queued behind it, each marked with dots for its stop, their order shuffling as dispatch updates it.

name: Route Drawn
alt: Two roads from a start point to a destination pin, the chosen one raised with the pin and the route drawn along it.

name: Route Matrix
alt: A street grid with two origins on one side, each routed along the streets to two stop pins of its own, the first origin's routes lit.

name: Pocket Navigator
alt: A phone lying screen up with a navigation app: a route runs along the map's streets from a position puck to a destination pin.

name: Lap Replay
alt: A map with a park and its pines, and a run along the street round it, the runner a puck and the stretch already run lit.

name: Corner Shop
alt: A shop on a street corner with a map pin over its roof.

name: Charge Point
alt: A lightning bolt hovering over a round charging pad.

name: Depot Belt
alt: Crates leaving a depot along a belt in stop order.

name: Heat Sun
alt: A sun with its rays reaching out.

name: Long Haul
alt: A car on a road from start to destination pin, with a charger halfway.

name: Walking Ring
alt: A home inside a walking ring, with a bus stop, a park and a shop around it.

name: Doorstep
alt: A parcel on the path to a front door.

name: Two Roads
alt: Two roads from a start point to a destination pin, one raised.

name: Shared Bay
alt: A small car and a bike parked nose to tail in a shared bay.

name: Geofence
alt: A delivery truck inside its geofence, with sonar rings around it.

name: Neighbourhood Moods
alt: Three faces standing on a street map, one per neighbourhood: happy, so-so and sad.

name: Pull Out
alt: A queue of cars nose to tail on a short road.
